title: Coworking spaces in Kochi with day passes
description: Find short-term coworking desks in Kochi, with day-pass details, booking links and map searches.
intro: Need a desk for a day or a few visits? These Kochi-area spaces advertise a day pass directly or through a booking provider. Some prices and access hours are supplied by third-party listings and may change; check the final price, tax, seat availability and whether a pass includes meeting rooms before paying. Map links are searches, not verified pins.

ordering.explanation: Places are listed alphabetically by name because comparable, source-checked quality and price information is not available for a fair ranking.

entries.name: AWFIS — Mezmatrix
entries.description: A bookable shared desk in the Mezmatrix building, listed by a coworking booking platform. Check the selected date and any fees at checkout.

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: Day-pass desk listed through myHQ; book for your chosen date.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: The platform uses credits and prices can vary by date or offer; check the final amount before paying.

facts.label: Calls
facts.value: Meeting rooms are listed separately; check availability and charges.

entries.name: Collective Coworks — Kakkanad
entries.description: A Kakkanad coworking space with a day-pass hot desk listed by Qdesq. The listing places it near Grand Central; confirm the exact entrance and booking before travelling.

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: Qdesq lists a day-pass hot desk.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: Qdesq lists a starting rate of ₹500 per day; confirm taxes and the current rate.

facts.label: Booking
facts.value: Request or book a seat through Qdesq; walk-in availability is unconfirmed.

entries.name: Corrazone Coworking — Kalamassery
entries.description: A Kalamassery workspace with day bookings for dedicated desks through GoFloaters. The listing says the space is next to Zamovar Restaurant.

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: GoFloaters describes an eight-hour day pass, subject to the workspace operating hours.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: GoFloaters lists ₹690 per day but its page conflicts on whether tax is included; confirm the final total.

facts.label: Facilities
facts.value: The listing mentions Wi-Fi and power backup; enquire about meeting-room availability and charges.

entries.name: Covspace — Chakkaraparambu
entries.description: A flexible workspace at G K Tower with a daily flexi-desk plan alongside longer-term options. The operator asks visitors to check seat availability.
entries.address: G K Tower, Chakkaraparambu Junction, Thammanam, Kochi 682032

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: The operator lists a flexi-desk daily pass; enquire about availability and access hours.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: ₹500 per day plus GST on the operator’s published price list; confirm current terms.

facts.label: Facilities
facts.value: Wi-Fi and electricity are listed; ask about day-pass use of the meeting room and parking.

entries.name: GreenNest — Kadavanthra
entries.description: The operator advertises individual day passes and multi-day packs at its Kadavanthra workspace, including a stated walk-in option.

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: Day pass; the operator says walk-ins are welcome and recommends calling ahead to secure a seat.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: The operator lists ₹400 per seat per day; confirm current pricing and taxes.

facts.label: Calls
facts.value: Designated call areas and meeting rooms are listed; check whether a room costs extra.

entries.name: Innerspace Coworking — Edappally
entries.description: An Edappally workspace near Good Earth Melange with a hot-desk day pass listed on Qdesq. The operator also advertises day passes; rates can differ by location and booking provider.

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: Qdesq lists a day pass for a flexible desk.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: Qdesq lists a starting rate of ₹500 per day; check current price and taxes.

facts.label: Facilities
facts.value: Wi-Fi and air conditioning are listed; confirm call space and power-backup access for the pass.

entries.name: Wagmi Workspace — AN Square
entries.description: An Edappally coworking space with a daily open-desk option on myHQ. Its listing includes the address and a date-selection step before booking.
entries.address: AN Square, Unichira Thoppil Road, Marottichuvadu, Edappally, Kochi 682021

facts.label: Short-term access
facts.value: The myHQ listing offers a bookable desk by the day.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: myHQ displays a price in credits; check conversion, taxes and the final payable amount.

facts.label: Calls
facts.value: The listing describes phone booths as limited and subject to availability; confirm access before booking.
